verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the sandbox guide, which says developers can create deposit addresses that receive testnet assets onto the Paxos platform. That shows some programmatic address provisioning, but nothing in the pack covers wallet creation or custody. Missing for 10: documented API for creating per-customer or per-purpose wallets, a deposit-address API reference with endpoint details, key custody semantics, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can create wallets programmatically — per-customer or per-purpose wallets and deposit addresses provisioned through the API with documented key custody semantics

citations.quote: When you create a deposit address in Sandbox, the generated address can be used to transfer test assets from a testnet or devnet wallet to the Paxos platform.
